_comment: Virtual Lab Studio bridge worker configuration.
Copy this file to worker.config.json and replace every <REPLACE_ME>.
The worker refuses to start while any placeholder remains, so an
unconfigured machine fails immediately instead of failing every job.
Never put a credential in this file. Model API keys are named here by
environment variable; the worker's own token lives in workerTokenFile.
displayName: <REPLACE_ME: a name you will recognise in the studio, e.g. Lab desktop (RTX 3090)>

models.modelKey: <REPLACE_ME: the name researchers will pick, e.g. local-qwen3-32b>
models.providerModelId: <REPLACE_ME: the id your server uses, e.g. qwen3:32b>
